# LJ Link

> Free, open-source app (Eclipse Public License 2.0) for lighting jockeys (LJs) in clubs, at festivals and at events. It shows every DJ deck live – waveforms, position, hot cues, memory cues, loops, beat grid, BPM and key – from Pioneer DJ players (Pro DJ Link) and Denon DJ players (StageLinQ), and sends the BPM to grandMA2, grandMA3 and Daslight, so no tap tempo is needed. macOS and Windows.

- Passive: it only listens and sends no commands to the DJ gear. No cloud, no telemetry.
- Pioneer and Denon at the same time; devices are added and removed automatically.
- Any tablet, phone or second screen in the network can open the same view.
- Older gear works too, not only CDJ-3000 and DJM-A9: every Pioneer player with a LINK port sends its tempo over Pro DJ Link. CDJ-2000NXS, CDJ-900NXS, XDJ-1000, XDJ-700 and DJM-900NXS are expected to work (not tested yet).
- Tested: CDJ-3000, CDJ-2000NXS2, DJM-2000NXS, Denon Prime 4+, grandMA2 onPC. grandMA3 follows the manual and is not yet tried on a desk; Daslight is not confirmed yet. Serato DJ Pro works on the same computer without play position. Traktor is planned.
- Not an official product of AlphaTheta / Pioneer DJ, inMusic / Denon DJ, MA Lighting or Daslight.

## Guides

- [Pioneer BPM to grandMA](https://skyplayser.github.io/LJ-Link-PRO/pioneer-bpm-grandma.html): send the tempo of Pioneer CDJs over Pro DJ Link to a grandMA2 (Telnet) or grandMA3 (OSC) speed master, compared with tap tempo, MIDI clock and Beat Link Trigger. German: https://skyplayser.github.io/LJ-Link-PRO/de/pioneer-bpm-grandma.html
- [Waveforms for the lightjockey](https://skyplayser.github.io/LJ-Link-PRO/lightjockey-waveforms.html): CDJ and Denon waveforms live at the light desk, on a laptop or tablet.
- [Denon StageLinQ for lighting](https://skyplayser.github.io/LJ-Link-PRO/denon-stagelinq-lighting.html): Prime 4+, Prime 4, Prime Go and SC6000 with waveforms, faders and BPM to grandMA.
